subject: Service interruption — proposed top-up and trial extension for SparkCommerce
messages:
From: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@sparkcommerce.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden 2hr outage this morning — immediate impact

Hi Jonas,

We experienced a 2-hour service interruption this morning (approx 06:30–08:30 PST) that caused failed generation calls and 500s across our checkout flow. Our telemetry shows a ~45% failed request rate during that window and a spike in latency for the hour after. This hit peak traffic and resulted in lost conversions — our ops and product teams are fairly concerned.

Can you confirm what happened, and what remediation or compensation Redwood can provide? We're evaluating whether to expand our dedicated capacity with Redwood, but need confidence around reliability and a concrete remedy for today's disruption.

I can share logs if useful. Appreciate a timely response.

—Ethan
Ethan Ward
Head of Platform, SparkCommerce
ethan.ward@sparkcommerce.com
+1 415 555 1212
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@sparkcommerce.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden 2hr outage this morning — immediate impact

Ethan —

Thanks for flagging and really sorry about the disruption this morning. We're already triaging with infra and the on-call team; initial signals point to a model routing cascade caused by a partial mempool eviction under heavier-than-expected burst traffic. That triggered degraded throughput and an elevated error rate while the system rehydrated caches.

Monica (cc) — I'm looping you in for immediate follow-up and to prepare an initial postmortem and an offer to make this right. Ethan, could you send the support bundle (request IDs/time ranges) so we can correlate your traces with cluster logs?

In parallel, I'd like to propose an immediate remedial package while we finish the postmortem: 12,000 token credit applied to your account and a 30-day trial extension on your Dedicated eval window (so you have more time to validate the Dedicated SLA). We'll confirm once we have formal approval from Marcus.

Would that be acceptable as an initial remedy? I can apply provisional credits within 24 hours pending sign-off.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SparkCommerce outage — proposed remedial package (12k tokens + 30d)

Marcus / Monica —

Forwarding SparkCommerce's outage report. They saw ~45% failed requests during 06:30–08:30 PST and post-incident elevated latency. I'm recommending we offer a goodwill package: 12,000 token credit + 30-day extension on their Dedicated evaluation window. Rationale: visible customer impact at peak, potential expansion opportunity (deal SPK-2026-047), and they'd signed up as part of our seasonal pilot.

Attachments: support logs they can share are referenced below — I asked them for the bundle. I'll apply the credit only with your approval; it should be outside the standard small-credit flow because of the size.

Key ask: please approve this package or advise alternate amount (I think 12k is conservative). I'm also proposing we offer an expedited postmortem and a 1:1 technical review with our infra team.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: SparkCommerce outage — proposed remedial package (12k tokens + 30d)

Jonas —

Approve the 12,000 token credit and the 30-day Dedicated evaluation extension. Please include a short note that this is a one-time remedial gesture tied to the 28Nov incident; flag to Finance so it's applied against SPK-2026-047 as a discretionary account credit. Also schedule the infra review with SparkCommerce (I want the runbook review notes).

Make sure we attach the postmortem draft and the support logs when we send confirmation. Also add an offer for a technical office hours session (30–45m) to walk through mitigation improvements.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Customer Success Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@sparkcommerce.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden 2hr outage this morning — confirmation of remedial package

Ethan —

Thanks again for the quick heads-up and for sharing the logs. Per Marcus's approval, we've applied the following remedial package to SparkCommerce (deal SPK-2026-047):

- 12,000 token credit applied to your account immediately (visible in billing > credits).
- 30-day extension to your Dedicated evaluation window, moving your expiry to 2027-01-14.
- Draft postmortem (attached) and support logs uploaded for your review.
- Offer: 30–45 minute technical review with our infra team to walk through the incident and mitigation steps.

Attachments: postmortem-draft.pdf (internal draft), spark-support-logs.tar.gz, usage-impact-summary.csv

Next steps: let me know a preferred slot for the infra review this week; we'll finalize the postmortem and circulate the redlines. If you'd like a different credit amount or a different form of remediation (e.g., extended SLA trial), tell me and I'll escalate.

Apologies again for the disruption — we take reliability seriously and will share concrete mitigations in the postmortem.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0199
From: Ethan Ward <ethan.ward@sparkcommerce.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden 2hr outage this morning — confirmation of remedial package

Jonas, Monica, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick coordination and for the credits. The 12k token top-up and 30-day extension are appreciated and should help offset the immediate impact while we evaluate Dedicated capacity. We'll review the postmortem and propose two times for the infra review (Tue 12/1 09:00 PST or Wed 12/2 14:00 PST).

Please mark HS-41297 as the case number for our internal tracking. We'll confirm a slot shortly.

—Ethan
